audience: accountants and finance teams in Brazil that check CNPJ data and issue NFS-e

useCases.title: Look up a company by CNPJ
useCases.text: Look up a CNPJ for the legal name, status, main activity and address. Look up the state tax registration of the company in one state.

useCases.title: Find the address for a postal code
useCases.text: Look up a CEP to get the street, district, city, state and IBGE city code.

useCases.title: Check an NF-e at SEFAZ
useCases.text: Query an NF-e by its 44-digit access key at SEFAZ. Read the issuer, items, totals and status.

useCases.title: List companies and service invoices
useCases.text: List the active companies of the account, then list the service invoices of one company by issue or creation date. Open one invoice.

useCases.title: Issue a service invoice (NFS-e)
useCases.text: Create one service invoice for a company in the city tax system. The answer is asynchronous, so check the final status afterwards.

useCases.title: Cancel a service invoice (NFS-e)
useCases.text: Cancel one service invoice at the city tax system. A cancellation cannot be undone and may have tax effects.
